en: Sepia-toned postcard showing a large neo‑Gothic brick manor or palace on a raised hill. A broad staircase leads up from the lawn to an ornate double stair and terrace at the central entrance. The façade is symmetrical with towers, crenellations, and many rectangular windows. Trees frame the building on both sides. At the bottom margin there is a caption in German spelling.
